components.name: Button
components.description: Quiet tinted button for toolbars, dialogs and Settings; never accent-filled.
components.css: .ds-button { font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foreground); background: var(--color-control); border: 1px solid var(--color-subtle-border); border-radius: var(--radius-medium); padding: 3px 10px; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--color-hover); } .ds-button:active { background: var(--color-pressed); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Borderless 26px icon-only button for toolbars and the sidebar header.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Refresh"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M13 8a5 5 0 1 1-1.5-3.5M13 3v2.5h-2.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-medium); background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--color-hover); color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Page-coloured field with an accent border and soft halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foreground); background: var(--color-background); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-medium); padding: 4px 8px; transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); opacity: 0.8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-accent-soft); }

components.name: Toolbar Search
components.description: Borderless filter field on the hover tint, used above trees and the CSV table.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 300px; height: 28px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-medium); background: var(--color-hover); color: var(--color-muted-foreground); transition: box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { background: var(--color-background); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-accent), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent-soft); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: none; background: none; padding: 0; font: 12.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foreground); outline: none; } .ds-search-count { font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Tinted track with a raised active segment: Formatted/Plain, Files/Outline, Settings choices.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: var(--radius-medium); background: var(--color-hover); } .ds-segmented button { border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-small); padding: 1px 10px; font: 11px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-segmented button:hover:not(.is-active) { color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-segmented button.is-active { background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Yes/no setting: pressed-tint pill that fills with the accent when on.
components.css: .ds-switch { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 36px; height: 22px; margin: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-pressed); transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-switch:checked { background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-switch:checked::after { transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-group { max-width: 640px; font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-group h2 { margin: 0 0 8px 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-group-rows { border-radius: var(--radius-large); background: var(--color-background); box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-subtle-border); } .ds-row-hint { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); }

components.name: Quick Open Result List
components.description: Fuzzy-match results; the active row is the one full accent fill in the app.
components.css: .ds-results { width: 420px; padding: 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-extra-large); background: var(--color-background); box-shadow: var(--shadow-popover); font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-result { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-medium); } .ds-result:hover { background: var(--color-hover); } .ds-result-name { font-weight: 500; } .ds-result-name mark { background: none; color: var(--color-accent); font-weight: 700; } .ds-result-dir { font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-result.is-active, .ds-result.is-active:hover { background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-background); } .ds-result.is-active mark { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-result.is-active .ds-result-dir { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-background) 75%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Jot is a sheet of paper with the app barely around it. The document fills the window and the chrome (a status bar, an optional sidebar and a toolbar over tree and table views) sits at the edges in small type and softly tinted greys. Nothing in the frame competes with the text, and when there's nothing to do the interface keeps quiet.

Colour belongs to the user, not to Jot. Every colour comes from the active theme: 21 built-in themes modelled on the most popular editor and terminal themes (Paper and Ink are the defaults, alongside GitHub, Tokyo Night, Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Solarized, Gruvbox, Rosé Pine and more), plus the user's own duplicates. So Jot's identity lives in **structure**: spacing, type sizes, corner radii, the flat-and-tonal depth model, and the way hover and selection states are *derived* from whatever theme is applied. A design that only looks right in Paper is broken.

The window content is platform-neutral. It renders the same on macOS and Linux and relies only on native menus, tabs and dialogs for platform behaviour.
keyCharacteristics: Simple and clean. The document leads and the chrome is small, tinted and quiet.
Theme-driven. Components use theme roles only, and state colours are mixed from them.
Flat and tonal. Depth comes from tinted surfaces and 1px borders, and shadows are rare.
Three fonts with three jobs: the UI font for chrome, the editor font for code and plain text, the writing font for prose.
Controls are quiet and are moving toward roomier. Today they are compact (11–13px), and new work should give them more padding and larger hit targets.

rules.name: The Theme Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: Components never hard-code a hex value. They use `var(--color-*)` roles, so every one of the 21+ themes (and any custom theme) works without a special case.

rules.name: The Derived State Rule
rules.body: Hover, pressed, soft-accent and control fills are `color-mix()` blends of the theme's own foreground, accent and surface (hover 7%, pressed 12%, control 5%, accent-soft 16%, accent-strong 28%). Never pick a separate hover colour per theme.

rules.name: The Three Fonts Rule
rules.body: The UI font is only for chrome, the editor font is for code and plain text, and the writing font is for Markdown prose. Never put the UI font inside the document, or a document font in the chrome.

rules.name: The User Sizes the Document Rule
rules.body: Document type scales from the user's `--font-size` and `--line-height` settings (and per-window zoom). Chrome type stays fixed in px.

rules.name: The Three Shadows Rule
rules.body: Raised for a selection or a grouped card, popover for something floating over the document, knob for the switch. Anything else is separated by tint and a 1px soft rule, never by a new shadow.

dos: **Do** take every colour from a theme role (`var(--color-*)`), and derive state colours with `color-mix()` from foreground, accent and surface (The Derived State Rule).
**Do** check new UI in at least Paper, Ink and one strongly coloured theme (such as Dracula or Solarized). A theme is a first-class use case, not a skin.
**Do** keep the accent for focus, selection, active state and links. The Quick Open active row is the only place it's a full fill.
**Do** separate regions with tint (page → chrome → surface) and 1px soft rules.

**Do** follow *quiet but roomier* for forms and settings: fields and buttons at least 30px tall, large segmented buttons at least 28px, a 36×22px switch, and labels and descriptions at 12–13px. Toolbars and the status bar stay compact.
**Do** keep chrome type in fixed px (11–13px, tabular numbers for counts) and let document type follow the user's font size and zoom.
**Do** keep the window content the same on macOS and Linux. Use system font stacks and nothing that only exists on one platform.
donts: **Don't** hard-code a hex colour in a component. The only fixed colours are danger, the white switch knob and the Markdown highlight yellow.
**Don't** add shadows beyond raised, popover and knob (The Three Shadows Rule).
**Don't** design for one theme. If it only works in Paper, it's broken.
**Don't** use the UI font inside the document, or a document font in the chrome (The Three Fonts Rule).
**Don't** fill buttons with the accent colour. Buttons are tinted and the accent marks state.
